definition: Dr A.R.D. Prasad is an Indian Library and Information Science Academic, Information professional and Information scientist.
details: Dr Prasad was a Professor at Documentation Research and Training Centre (DRTC), Bangalore as Professor of Library and Information Science and he is retired Head of DRTC, which is India's only proper ischool with a very strong research program. His areas of specialisation include Artificial intelligence-Applications in LIS, Natural language processing, Digital Libraries, Hypertext and Multimedia applications, Institutional repository, Open-source software used in Libraries, Open Access to Information, Semantic Web Technology, Free and open source software etc. His other area of interests are Mythology, Buddhism, Philosophy and Indian History. He is pioneer in the promotion and development of Open-source software used in Libraries and Information Centres in India, Open access (publishing) and Open Access movement. He is visiting Faculty of University of Trento, Italy.

explainer.lead: A. R. D. Prasad is an Indian library and information scientist who led the Documentation Research and Training Centre (DRTC) at the Indian Statistical Institute, Bangalore, and championed open-source digital libraries and open access in India.
explainer.knownFor: Bringing open-source digital-library software and open access to Indian libraries, and applying natural language processing and semantic-web methods to library indexing.

contributions.name: Open-source digital libraries
contributions.detail: Trained Indian librarians on Greenstone and DSpace through DRTC and wrote practical guides, such as installing Greenstone on Linux.

contributions.name: Endangered-language repositories
contributions.detail: Built digital repositories for the endangered tribal languages of Tamil Nadu and for the Central Institute of Indian Languages.

contributions.name: NLP for subject indexing
contributions.detail: His PhD at Karnatak University applied natural language processing tools to the design of subject indexing languages.

contributions.name: Semantic web research
contributions.detail: Worked on the European Commission’s Living Knowledge project and taught as visiting faculty at the University of Trento, Italy.

contributions.name: National policy
contributions.detail: Served on a National Knowledge Commission working group, the DSpace Governance Advisory Committee and UGC committees on curricula and electronic theses.

timeline.what: Co-writes DRTC’s step-by-step guide to running Greenstone digital libraries on Linux

keyWorks.title: Installing Greenstone Digital Library Software on Linux Systems

affiliations: Documentation Research and Training Centre, Indian Statistical Institute
